bio: Henry Rose was born in 1861 at Essen, Germany, and emigrated to America in 1881 or 1882. In 1885 he married Mary Meier at Hazleton, Pennsylvania, where the couple made their home. Their daughter Josephine's 1920 marriage record names her parents as Henry Rose and Mary, née Meyers, both born in Germany. Henry died at Hazleton on 19 May 1927.
